entries.04b6a95b29397a34: This business manufactures and sells clay roof tiles (Ｊ-type and Ｆ-type tiles), undertakes and carries out roofing work, manufactures and sells ceramic panel wall materials, and develops and sells building materials; the company has a single segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,505 million.
entries.113c039d000498cf: Customers are housing companies that build detached houses, and some housing companies specify the company's products as components of detached houses from the design stage.
entries.18d9f9e00ab7487c: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,505 million; by product in sales results, Ｆ-type roof tiles were ¥4,019 million, Ｊ-type roof tiles ¥1,548 million, other merchandise ¥427 million, construction revenue ¥356 million, and ceramic wall panels and others ¥152 million.
entries.27cec0250de5c37a: It has formulated a medium-term management plan covering the fiscal years ending March 2027 to March 2029 and, with “Challenge: Environments Change, So Keep Thinking and Keep Taking On New Challenges” as its vision, states that it will promote concrete measures centered on evolving and deepening the clay roof tile business, expanding the ceramic panel business, challenging new areas, and strengthening the management foundation.
entries.3f086f2d925a3c3b: This is based on the business characteristics in the management policy, which prints that high durability (long life) is the differentiating factor of clay roof tiles, and that as a company with the largest production capacity in Japan, continuing stable supply and contributing to the maintenance and development of the clay roof tile industry is its social responsibility.
entries.4d56edd9e9ca0f21: As housing styles become more Western, demand continues to shift from Japanese-style Ｊ-type roof tiles to Western-style Ｆ-type roof tiles, and the sales results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were centered on Ｆ-type roof tiles.
entries.4dced3ccd8d469ad: Founded as an individual business in Kariya City, Aichi Prefecture in 1887, the company became a stock company in 1968 and has its head office in Handa City, Aichi Prefecture.
entries.533241b7f5037948: It is a business model that earns revenue mainly from manufacturing and sales of clay roof tiles, roofing contracting and construction, manufacturing and sales of ceramic wall panels, and sales of building materials.
entries.59955dc6116bed59: High durability (long life) as a roofing material is considered a differentiating factor for clay roof tiles, and as a company with the largest production capacity in Japan, the company has continued stable supply over a long period.
entries.624e8b96ae3aab49: This is based on the summary of business results and financial condition in the filing, which prints that sales activities were carried out to increase the number of buildings adopted by domestic housing companies and expand construction orders, that overseas sales rose 65.2% year on year, and that owner-occupied housing starts remained at a low level, declining by about 10% or more year on year.
entries.739f2ddf1fca52de: Clay roof tiles, ceramic wall panels and roofing work
entries.814eaa1c30c31ddf: Founded as an individual business in Kariya City, Aichi Prefecture in 1887, the company became a stock company in 1968 and has its head office in Handa City, Aichi Prefecture. Employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 321.
entries.8f0b560f88744b22: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the company worked to increase the number of buildings adopted by domestic housing companies, expand construction orders, and expand overseas sales centered on Asia, but was affected by the decline in owner-occupied housing starts.

entries.c324559d127ae37a: This is based on the analysis of business results, which prints that demand continues to shift from Ｊ-type to Ｆ-type roof tiles as housing styles become more Western, and on sales results printed as Ｆ-type roof tiles ¥4,019 million and Ｊ-type roof tiles ¥1,548 million.

entries.ceea9a4cb947525f: Net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥373 million.
